rule_reason: Passive radio/network measurements do not contain attempted-transmission outcomes/denominator.
Selected passive NB-IoT file contains radio/network measurements, not end-to-end application latency.
Selected passive NB-IoT file contains no device energy measurement.
Operational NB-IoT RSRP/RSRQ/SINR and serving-cell context can support a threshold/model bridge to link feasibility, but do not directly measure a probability estimand.
No lifecycle procurement/tariff cost estimand in the selected file.
LoRaWAN sniffer records are observed receptions; without all attempted transmissions the delivery denominator is absent, so only conditional traffic/reception characterization is admissible.
Sniffer packet observations do not identify matched application end-to-end latency.
Received-packet PHY/context can support an explicit observational link-context bridge, not a direct probability of serviceability.
Energy traces do not identify attempted-versus-delivered message probability.
Trace segmentation does not identify application end-to-end latency.
Measured NB-IoT modem/device-side energy components and packet energy require an explicit bridge to the STACKWISE whole-device application-report boundary and workload.
RSRP/RSSI/SINR/RSRQ and coverage-enhancement context accompany energy measurements but do not directly identify operational link-feasibility probability.
